long_biography.plain_text:
EuroChem and SUEK grew from a collection of industrial plants and mines assembled by Andrey Melnichenko and business partner Sergei Popov. Melnichenko had studied physics in Moscow before leaving university during the Soviet Union's collapse. Currency-exchange booths established with fellow students evolved into MDM Bank, giving him the financial platform and partnerships for large-scale industrial acquisitions.

After leaving banking, Melnichenko concentrated on fertilisers and coal, building vertically integrated groups across mining, manufacturing and distribution. EuroChem now spans the supply chain from raw materials to farm delivery, while SUEK became a major thermal-coal producer. The Andrey Melnichenko Foundation draws on his scientific background through regional education infrastructure and programmes focused on food security and climate action.
